items.title: Amazon CloudWatch log centralization now available in AWS GovCloud and additional commercial Regions
items.content_snippet: Amazon CloudWatch log centralization is now available in AWS GovCloud (US) and 13 additional commercial Regions. CloudWatch log centralization copies log data from multiple AWS accounts and Regions into a single destination account, integrating with AWS Organizations for efficient aggregation without the need for custom solutions. items.title: AWS Lambda durable functions are now available in AWS GovCloud (US) Regions
items.content_snippet: AWS Lambda durable functions are now available in the AWS GovCloud (US-West) and AWS GovCloud (US-East) Regions. Lambda durable functions enable developers to build reliable multi-step applications and AI workflows within the Lambda developer experience. items.title: The AI Bill Is Too Damn High: Tokenomics 101 — Eugene Cheah, Featherless AI
items.content_snippet: If your token spend keeps going up and productivity isn't keeping pace, start here. Eugene Cheah lays out four steps for cutting AI inference costs at scale: measure, right-size, buy capacity well and check your processes. Along the way he covers splitting API keys per team, agentic vs. process workloads, open models that match frontier models on specific tasks, classifiers, fine-tuning, the speed-vs-cost tradeoff and "slop grenades."
